arguments.sql:
SELECT
    d.delivery_status,
    COUNT(*) AS delivery_rows,
    COUNT(o.order_id) AS joined_order_rows,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.delivery_id) AS unique_delivery_ids,
    SUM(NULLIF(TRIM(o.order_moment_delivered), '') IS NOT NULL) AS with_delivered_timestamp,
    SUM(NULLIF(TRIM(o.order_moment_finished), '') IS NOT NULL) AS with_finished_timestamp,
    SUM(o.order_created_year IS NOT NULL AND o.order_created_month IS NOT NULL AND o.order_created_day IS NOT NULL) AS with_creation_date
FROM main.deliveries AS d
LEFT JOIN main.orders AS o ON o.delivery_order_id = d.delivery_order_id
GROUP BY d.delivery_status
ORDER BY d.delivery_status
